## Selected systems from the portfolio

- Aetos: Trustless venture-DAO platform built at TrueOrigin Labs. On-chain capital calls, proposals, siloed vaults, and returns. Docs: https://aetos.gitbook.io/aetos.vc. Underpins Book Club (https://www.bookclub.wtf).
- Flow: High-frequency copytrading system on Solana and Ethereum (TrueOrigin Labs). Trading front-end, 0-block latency execution.
- SigIntZero: Smart-contract audit and security firm (Chief Digital Officer). Sentinel AI scans, senior audits, and Tripwire runtime monitoring. Live: https://sigintzero.com.
- Yieldly: The first DeFi suite on Algorand (tech co-founder, lead frontend). Staking pools and no-loss prize games.
- Book Club: APAC crypto venture community running on Aetos (founding team). 9 teams backed, $10M+ collective revenue. Live: https://www.bookclub.wtf.
- MantraDAO: DeFi staking and governance. Full-stack product engineering in the TrueOrigin external team.
- Shuriken: Low-latency trading systems behind the Ethereum launch (core dev team). Live: https://shuriken.trade.
- TrueOrigin: Onchain product authenticity and supply-chain provenance (co-founder). The studio's namesake.
